prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption hints, choose path hints, finish notifications, and home notifications, as each has only 1 test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout), finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen), and sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) can be helpful, each producing 1 winning test across multiple tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) and adoption redesign changes (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption new flow changes (adoption, new_flow) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests, with 1 test performing significantly worse.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic overall, but underpredicted winning tests in path layout (Round 2) and finish new screen (Round 3).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_flow: -1.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +0.7% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.4% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, notification: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.5% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.7% after noise correction, 5 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.3%

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen layout into a stage showcase highlight to clearly distinguish custom creation versus pre-made template pets. (why: choose_path loses ~20% of users with high mean completion time (514s), and path layout changes previously yielded a winning test.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Sign In Screen Flow Reorder: Reorder the flow by moving sign_in after pet adoption so users choose or design their desktop pet before creating or logging into an account. (why: Sign-in loses 23.1% of users before they build emotional investment in a pet, while 8 support tickets cite confusion around sync and missing pets upon re-login.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Cloud Pet Safeguard Banner: Display a prominent safeguard hint on the sign_in screen detailing how signing in protects pet data from resetting upon app restart. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in hints have a history of winning tests.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Command Center Layout Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing quick desktop interaction shortcuts alongside final completion steps. (why: Finish screen has the highest overall mean duration (5815s) and 3 support emails note users are confused about how to control or talk to their desktop pet.)
4: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Confirmation Headline Copy: Update the adoption_certificate screen headline and body copy to clearly explain profile naming and pet saving guarantees. (why: Adoption is the biggest funnel leak (60.9% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s) where clearer progress copy can reduce hesitation.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Stage Render Completion Desktop Sound Alert: Enable notification and time estimate controls on the waiting screen to alert users when rendering completes. (why: The waiting screen has an extreme mean time of 2336s vs a median of 201s, indicating users tab away and forget to return to complete setup.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Screen Compact Centered Layout: Reframe the sign_in screen into a centered compact layout with streamlined authentication options. (why: Sign in step drops 23.1% of users; a cleaner visual layout reduces perceived effort for account setup.)

scores.note: Choose path drops 19.4% with high mean completion time; path layout redesigns produced 1 winning test historically.
Sign-in drops 23.1% and 8 support tickets mention sync/missing pet confusion, though major flow reorders carry execution risk.
Both support emails and funnel data highlight sign-in drops, and sign-in hints have a proven track record of winning tests.
Finish stage drops 30.5% with extreme mean duration (5815s) and support complaints; redesigns have yielded winning tests.
Adoption is the largest funnel drop (39.1%), but copy/hint changes have limited historical evidence.
High mean vs median time suggests users tab away during wait; home notifications showed positive single-test results.
Sign-in stage drops 23.1% of users; layout reframing reduces friction with moderate historical success.
